description: Internal route the Node client calls, one process per operation. Not a user verb. The caller serializes calls of one groupKey (one promise queue per coordinating process).

shape.herdrBin: optional string; resolveHerdrBin() of the caller (FGOS_HERDR_BIN or herdr)
shape.env: optional object of string; driver environment overrides such as HERDR_SESSION and HERDR_SOCKET_PATH for a confined round's own herdr server; FGOS_HERDR_ANCHOR_PANE names the pane `capabilities` reports on
shape.config: optional object: minCols, minRows (integers at or above the measured floor 40x8), maxPanesPerTab (integer >= 1), policy (a registered name), allocationGraceMs, launchIdentifyTimeoutMs, shellReadyTimeoutMs; absent keys keep the defaults the capabilities result lists (80x20, 8 panes, measured-split, 60000, 5000, 10000)
shape.timeoutMs: optional integer >= 1: the caller's whole budget for this operation; herdr commands may use nine tenths of it, so a stuck command is answered unknown before the caller gives up

exitCodes.0: the operation produced a port result (including unsupported and unknown)
exitCodes.2: usage error (unknown op, bad JSON, missing field, a config the core refuses)

notes: exit code 3 for host-version-mismatch matches the other internal routes (internal-route.lock-fd.v1.json)
the state root comes from the same single resolution as holder-lock (state-root.vectors.v1.json); the route never resolves its own
